name: pickthetcg
description: Prices for Vibes cards and vintage Pokémon cards (Base Set to Skyridge) from eBay sold listings: each printing, finish and grade with its usual range and how sure it is, as a price card with a link to the card's page.

interface.longDescription:
pickthetcg prices trading cards from real eBay sales: Vibes, the Pudgy Penguins card game, and vintage Pokémon cards from Base Set to Skyridge (1999 to 2003).

Ask the way you would ask a friend: "What is a Base Set Charizard worth?" or "How much is a PSA 10 Nyan Cat?". pickthetcg answers from its own price guide:
• The usual raw copy's price, the range most copies sell in, and how many sales stand behind it.
• Each printing, finish and grade priced on its own: 1st Edition, Shadowless and Unlimited; Holo foil and Arctic foil; PSA, CGC and BGS grades.
• How sure each price is: high confidence, good sample or best guess.
• Promos shown apart: a separate printing, never the card's own price.
• A price card with the versions, their ranges and a link to the card's page.
• Cards in price order, for one game or one set.
• It reads card names the way collectors write them, with typos, nicknames and numbers such as 4/102.

Prices are medians of eBay sold listings, updated monthly: a guide, not an offer. pickthetcg is independent and not affiliated with the makers of Vibes or Pokémon.
defaultPrompt: What is a Base Set Charizard worth?
How much is a PSA 10 Nyan Cat Vibes card?
Which Vibes cards sell for the most?

positive.prompt: What is a Base Set Charizard worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price card for Charizard, Base Set 4/102: the usual raw copy (Unlimited) with the range most copies sell in and how sure the price is, then the Shadowless and graded copies, names the other Charizard cards to ask about, and ends with the credit and a link to the card's page on pickthetcg.

positive.description: One grade of a Vibes card
positive.prompt: How much is a PSA 10 Nyan Cat Vibes card?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price card for Nyan Cat (Vibes, Legend of the Lils) leading with the PSA 10 copy's price and how sure it is, a best guess when few have sold, with the raw copy's price beside it and a link to the card's page.

positive.prompt: Which Vibes cards sell for the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Vibes cards in price order, high to low, each with the version it is ranked by (often a PSA 10), its price, how sure it is and a link to the card, and gives the full list on pickthetcg.

positive.description: Finding cards by name and set
positive.prompt: Find the Unown cards from Neo Discovery
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Unown cards of Neo Discovery with their letters and numbers, each with the usual raw copy's price and a link to its page, and offers the full prices of any of them.

positive.description: A promo apart from the card
positive.prompt: Is a Striker Birb promo worth more than the regular card?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price card for Striker Birb (Vibes) with the regular card's usual raw price, and its NSCC 2026 Panini promo printings apart, each with its own price, saying a promo is a separate printing and not the card's price.

negative.description: Weather is not a card price
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?

negative.description: Currency conversion is not a card price

publication.release_notes: First version: prices for Vibes cards and vintage Pokémon cards from eBay sold listings, each printing, finish and grade with how sure it is, as a price card; a card search; and cards in price order.
